verdict.rationale: Runloop publishes its own recipe for running a coding agent in a devbox: an OpenCode tutorial with a blueprint workflow, plus an Axon/ACP broker example that streams OpenCode output. Supporting pieces back this up: 'running agents on sandboxes' tutorials, mounting pre-configured AI agents into devboxes, a PTY for agent TUIs, and Agent Gateways for Anthropic/OpenAI calls without exposing API keys. missing for 10: an explicit Claude Code or Codex recipe in the evidence (only OpenCode is named), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these recipes work.
